# Saved Stripe changelog pages

Stripe's API changelog for the `2026-09-30.endive` release, as markdown (each page's URL plus `.md`). `TestIndexFetchesAVersionsEntriesAndAttachesHints` serves these from a local server in place of docs.stripe.com.

**License:** excerpts for testing; © Stripe, Inc. Not covered by this repo's license.

**Trimmed.** Each entry page keeps only what `hint.Parse` reads: the title, the "What's new" section and the "Changes → REST API" table, copied unchanged. The "Why is this a breaking change?", "Impact", per-SDK and "Upgrade" sections were left out. `endive.md` keeps only the release's index tables.

| File | URL | Fetched | Quote |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endive.md` | https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md | 2026-10-13 | "Endive is the fifth release" |
| `polymorphic-billing-cycle-anchor.md` | https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive/2026-09-30/polymorphic-billing-cycle-anchor.md | 2026-10-13 | "Unifies the billing cycle anchor format across Subscriptions and Invoices" |
| `remove-payment-method-types-checkout-sessions.md` | https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive/2026-09-30/remove-payment-method-types-checkout-sessions.md | 2026-10-13 | "You can no longer pass `payment_method_types` when you create a Checkout Session." |
| `removed-payto-fields.md` | https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive/2026-09-30/removed-payto-fields.md | 2026-10-13 | "Removes PayTo-specific fields from Payment Methods" |
| `removes-the-payment-method-types-parameter-from-payment-intents-and-setup-intents.md` | https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive/2026-09-30/removes-the-payment-method-types-parameter-from-payment-intents-and-setup-intents.md | 2026-10-13 | "Removes the payment method types parameter from Payment Intents and Setup Intents" |
| `trial-offer-ga.md` | https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive/2026-09-30/trial-offer-ga.md | 2026-10-13 | "Makes trial offers generally available" |
